subject: Road Rage online ideas
author: ZombieTron
body:
Welcome to BurnoutAholics!

Yeah, no road rage online kinda threw me until I played the full game and realised that it would be really awkward in an open world - way too difficult for the Red Team to catch anybody!

But, you can still play your own Road Rage games, especially when you open more cars when you are near to completing the game.

Get half the room in Hunter Citizen's and have the Cops chase down and take out the illegal street racers.

Or make your own Marked Man game by getting everybody in Carbon Cars except one Marked Man who has to survive as long as they can.

😃
